items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: When your wife is running the finances, you got to say something about it.

ctx.x: Was he running the finances or was Gladys running the finances? (inaudible)?

Oh, yes. After all, it was his band. When your wife is running the finances, you got to say something about it. You know, you can't duck under too many skirts always, you know. People always try to find out different reasons why certain things don't happen. They can find excuses. But I formed his big band, put it together. He became a millionaire. Then, when I was in the service, after I left his band, he never even came by to take me out to dinner and I put his band together for him.
